d: Own Valour's day-to-day visual output, from concept and shoot through design, edit and publishing. You'll make sure every asset across social, campaign, e-commerce and retail looks unmistakably Valour, working from our studio, The Avenues store and events.

This is a hybrid role. You'll design and you'll film: static ads, carousels and campaign visuals one day, product shoots and reels the next. Your portfolio matters more than your degree, and it needs to show both.

r: Create social media posts, campaign visuals, ads, banners and marketing materials for digital and print
Adapt assets across platforms and formats: Instagram, TikTok, Meta ads, website, email and in-store
Protect and apply Valour's visual identity consistently, and keep templates and brand asset libraries organised
Plan and run product, model and lifestyle shoots, including styling, props and location coordination
Shoot and edit short-form video: reels, TikToks, stories and product videos

d: As the world's largest family of luxury hotels, we all take great pride in being genuine ambassadors of the InterContinental® brand.

Shaped by decades of international know-how and local insights, our passion for luxury travel spans cultures and customs. Inspiring us to create warm and sophisticated experiences for those seeking a richer perspective on the world. Each of our hotels cultivates a distinctive style and ambience where we embrace every opportunity to give our guests a personal and enriching experience.
If you'd like to embrace a wider world of experiences and opportunities, we'd like to welcome you to the world's most international luxury hotel brand.

Located on Doha's longest private beach and nestled in landscaped gardens, the InterContinental Doha Beach & Spa features 12 restaurants, a range of recreational facilities, a free-form swimming pool, and the world-class Spa InterContinental.

Situated in an exclusive location, minutes from downtown Doha and major government and corporate offices and within minutes to the Doha Exhibition and Convention Centre, City Center Mall, and Doha Golf Club, our properties offer distinctive surroundings which will forever redefine luxury.

As a Marketing Executive, you will support the development and execution of marketing activities that strengthen the hotel's brand presence, drive awareness, support revenue-generating initiatives, and engage both existing and prospective guests.

Working closely with Marketing, Sales, Revenue Management, Food & Beverage, Rooms, and other departments, you will help bring campaigns, promotions, content, and brand initiatives to life across digital and offline channels.

The ideal candidate will combine creativity with strong execution skills, have a good understanding of digital marketing and social media, and be passionate about luxury hospitality and creating compelling guest experiences.
r: Support the planning and execution of integrated marketing campaigns across the hotel's key business segments and outlets.
Assist in developing promotional campaigns for rooms, restaurants, bars, spa, events, residences, and seasonal experiences.
Coordinate campaign timelines, content requirements, approvals, and implementation across relevant channels.
Work closely with Food & Beverage and Commercial teams to support the promotion of new concepts, offers, events, and activations.
Monitor campaign performance and provide regular updates on reach, engagement, leads, conversions, and other relevant metrics.
Support the development of creative ideas and marketing activations that increase awareness and guest engagement.
Support the hotel's social media strategy and day-to-day content calendar.
Coordinate the creation, scheduling, and publishing of engaging content across relevant social media platforms.
Work with internal teams, photographers, videographers, agencies, and content creators to develop high-quality visual and written content.
Ensure all digital content is aligned with the InterContinental brand identity and hotel positioning.
Monitor social media engagement and respond or coordinate responses to relevant guest interactions where appropriate.
Identify relevant trends, content opportunities, and digital platforms that can strengthen the hotel's online presence.
Support paid digital campaigns and coordinate with external agencies or relevant partners where required.
Develop and coordinate marketing content including social media posts, promotional materials, newsletters, presentations, digital assets, and internal communications.
Ensure marketing materials are accurate, engaging, and aligned with brand standards.
Maintain an organized library of current marketing assets, photography, videos, logos, and promotional materials.
Ensure all published information regarding hotel facilities, outlets, offers, opening hours, and experiences is accurate and up to date.
Assist in coordinating media visits, influencer stays, content collaborations, and hotel events.
Support the preparation of press releases, media materials, talking points, and other communication content.
Maintain relationships with relevant media, influencers, content creators, and local partners as directed by the Marketing leadership.
Identify opportunities to increase the hotel's visibility through relevant local events, partnerships, and media channels.
Support the development of strategic partnerships with relevant local businesses, lifestyle brands, tourism partners, and community organizations.
Assist in identifying opportunities for joint promotions, collaborations, and cross-marketing initiatives.
Support hotel participation in relevant local events and promotional activities.
Research local market trends, consumer behavior, competitor activity, and emerging marketing opportunities.
Work closely with Sales, Revenue Management, Food & Beverage, Rooms, and other commercial teams to ensure marketing activities support the hotel's business objectives.
Provide marketing insights and campaign results to support future commercial decision-making.
Prepare regular reports covering social media performance, campaign results, content performance, and other relevant marketing KPIs.
Ideally, you'll have some or all of the following competencies and experience we're looking for:
Previous experience in Marketing, Digital Marketing, Communications, Hospitality Marketing, or a related field.
Previous experience within a luxury hotel or hospitality environment is an advantage.
Good understanding of social media platforms, digital marketing, content creation, and campaign execution.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Creative mindset with an ability to develop engaging content and marketing ideas.
Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
Ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, and stakeholders simultaneously.
Good understanding of basic marketing analytics and campaign performance measurement.
Comfortable working with creative agencies, photographers, videographers, designers, influencers, and external partners.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office; experience with content management, social media management, email marketing, or design tools is an advantage.
Strong English communication skills; additional languages are an advantage.
A degree or qualification in Marketing, Communications, Business, Hospitality, or a related field is preferred.
We’ll reward all your hard work with competitive salary and benefits.
